content: TanStack Query + Next.js App Router SSR pitfalls: (1) creating a QueryClient at module scope on the server causes cross-request cache leakage across users — must use a per-request factory function; the browser instead needs a singleton so re-renders don't drop the cache. (2) default staleTime is 0, so prefetched/hydrated data is instantly considered stale and the client immediately refetches after hydration, causing a visible double-fetch/flicker — set a non-zero staleTime matching how fresh the SSR data should be treated. (3) pattern: prefetch in a Server Component, dehydrate(), pass through HydrationBoundary, rehydrate on the client; keep server-owned vs client-owned data ownership clear to avoid sync bugs.
